en.first_paragraph: Similar to ChatGPT’s built-in personality presets, you can steer your Agent’s behavior by explicitly defining its personality in your prompt instructions. These instructions—sometimes called the “system prompt” or “developer prompt”—guide the agent’s tone, detail level, and style of responses. en.first_paragraph: Two weeks ago I made a bet with Vitalik that one person could agentic-code an Ethereum client targeting the entire 2030+ roadmap. Completed-roadmap Ethereum is a genuinely extraordinary machine - 10,000+ TPS on L1, finality in seconds instead of 15 minutes, solo staking for 1 ETH, stateless nodes on a $7 Raspberry Pi, over a million TPS across L1+L2 - but that future depends on 65 planned upgrades across eight phases actually fitting together. The specs are scattered across dozens of EIPs, many still in draft. Nobody had tried to build all of them into one codebase to see if they compose. So I did.
